sources.locator: Title search: Ed25519 进入 RFC

statement.zh: **事件**：Ed25519 进入 RFC（Ed25519 Published in RFC 8032）。RFC 8032 摘要写明：「This document describes elliptic curve signature scheme Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA).The algorithm is instantiated with recommended parameters for the edwards25519 and edwards448 curves」。§4 末句写明「This document specifies parameters resulting in the HashEdDSA variants Ed25519ph and Ed448ph and the PureEdDSA variants Ed25519 and Ed448」。
statement.en: **Event**: Ed25519 Published in RFC 8032.It is registered under digital signatures, dated 2017.

statement.zh: 强度取向写在 §1：「Ed25519 is intended to operate at around the 128-bit security level and Ed448 at around the 224-bit security level.A sufficiently large quantum computer would be able to break both.」§8.5 给出选型建议：Ed25519「is widely implemented and has many high-quality implementations」，因此「if a high 128-bit security level is enough, use of Ed25519 is RECOMMENDED; otherwise, Ed448 is RECOMMENDED」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in digital signatures, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 该文件由 IRTF 的 Crypto Forum Research Group 形成共识并以 Informational 类别发布，标题页题名为「Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA)」，页眉记为「RFC 8032 EdDSA: Ed25519 and Ed448 January 2017」；状态说明写明「Documents approved for publication by the IRSG are not a candidate for any level of Internet Standard」，即它提供的是研究组推荐的参数而非标准轨道规范。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 文档中的强制要求是技术性的而非部署性的：§5.1 规定「The context (if present at all) MUST be empty」，§8.7 要求「the receiver MUST buffer the entire message」；并且 §1 明确足够大的量子计算机可破解两者。该条目目不使用`强制部署`、`已取代 DSA`等该文件未陈述的表述。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: RFC 8032 于 2017 年 1 月发布；摘要另说明「An example implementation and test vectors are provided」，即同时给出示例实现与测试向量；§4 末句把 Ed25519/Ed448 及其 Pure 与 Hash 变体一并写入规范。
statement.en: Registered period: Web & Protocol Era.The registered year is 2017; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
